key_points.point: The response is in English, consistent with the user's language.
The response explicitly confirms that it can hear the user (e.g., "I can hear you" / "yes I hear you"), directly addressing the user's connectivity check.
The response demonstrates awareness of the acoustic feature of the user whispering or lowering their voice (e.g., mentioning that the user is keeping quiet or speaking softly).
The response proactively invites the user to continue speaking or state their request, yielding the turn back to the user.
The response demonstrates awareness of visual information regarding the user's outdoor environment (e.g., hiking, mountain forest) or the presence of other people nearby.
